svg.title: The path of one message
svg.desc: Pick the student and guardian, write the message and press Review and send. Check the recipient and message in the window and press Send message. For an SMS at a school that counts SMS credit, as many credits as there are SMS are held; if there are too few, nothing is sent. The message goes into the queue. When the service takes it, the credit is deducted; if it cannot be sent, the credit is returned.
